# Pomodoro Timer

Start a 25-minute focus timer with break reminders.

## Usage

When the user asks for a pomodoro timer:
1. Set a 25-minute work timer
2. Notify when time is up
3. Suggest a 5-minute break
4. After 4 cycles, suggest a 15-minute break
